$$タケル$$
「I swear it, Mother.
　Victory and peace, to $$マーグ#pilot$$'s soul.」

stage0098a_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$タケル$$
（$$甲児$$ said he wasn't going back to
　$$くろがね屋$$, but I wonder how he's doing...）

stage0098a_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$さやか$$
「Was it really okay, $$甲児$$...
　not going to $$くろがね屋$$?」

stage0098a_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$甲児$$
「No point going back with Mom not there...
　What about you, $$さやか$$? Don't you need
　to go to the Science Fortress Institute?」

stage0098a_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$さやか$$
「Father's been busy dealing with
　$$バアル$$ too, it seems.
　So we talked a lot over comms instead.」

stage0098a_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$さやか$$
「Besides... the person I want to spend
　time with... is here...」

stage0098a_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$渓$$
「Hey... if you're gonna flirt, could you
　do it somewhere else? I'm busy tuning
　$$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ over here.」

stage0098a_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$凱$$
「What are you talking about, boss.
　You always glare somethin' fierce
　whenever $$渓$$ talks to a guy.」

stage0098a_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$渓$$
「$$凱$$'s right.
　I'm at that age too, you know, so it's
　not weird if I fall in love or something...」

stage0098a_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$弁慶$$
「L-love!?
　$$渓$$! You're way too young for that!」

stage0098a_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$渓$$
「The Earth might not even exist tomorrow,
　and you're on about too early or late!」

stage0098a_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$弁慶$$
「What did you say!
　Are you planning to fight like you intend to lose!?」

stage0098a_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$甲児$$
「Then, for the sake of love too,
　we've absolutely got to win.」

stage0098a_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$渓$$
「What, Pop!
　Are you saying I should lose, then!?」

stage0098a_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$竜馬$$
「$$弁慶$$'s doting-dad act really runs deep.」

stage0098a_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$隼人$$
「That's a world with nothing to do with us.」

stage0098a_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Heh... guess that means neither of us has anyone to say goodbye to.」

stage0098a_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$隼人$$
「Don't get the wrong idea, $$竜馬$$.
　Since we'll definitely come back, there's no need for goodbyes.」

stage0098a_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$號$$
「That's right.
　Our battle has no end.」

stage0098a_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$竜馬$$
「An endless battle, huh...
　Not bad.」

stage0098a_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$甲児$$
「I know.
　$$シロー$$ and the others are waiting over there too.」

stage0098a_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$甲児$$
（What are $$カミーユ$$ and $$シン$$ up to, out in space...）

stage0098a_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$アスラン$$
「...I believe in your victory, $$キラ$$.」

stage0098a_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$エマ$$
「$$シン$$, is it all right if you don't talk to $$ルナマリア$$?」

stage0098a_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$ファ$$
「It's fine, Lieutenant $$エマ$$.
　$$シン$$ was on the comm with Luna all last night.」

stage0098a_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$エマ$$
「Guess that was unnecessary meddling on my part.」

stage0098a_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$フォウ$$
「Aren't you going to see Captain Henken, Lieutenant $$エマ$$?」

stage0098a_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$エマ$$
「They seem busy dealing with $$バアル$$, too...」

stage0098a_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$カツ$$
「Lieutenant $$エマ$$... since when have you and Captain Henken been...」

stage0098a_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$フォウ$$
「She lost to the Captain's fierce advances.」

stage0098a_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You sure know a lot, $$フォウ$$...」

stage0098a_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$フォウ$$
「While $$カミーユ$$ and the others were at $$ＡＤＷ$$,
　I... was in the same unit as Lieutenant $$エマ$$.」

stage0098a_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$フォウ$$
「So I even saw the moment Lieutenant $$エマ$$
　got shot down by Captain Henken.」

stage0098a_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You look happy about losing, Lieutenant $$エマ$$.」

stage0098a_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$シン$$
「But we can't afford to lose.
　Not for the sake of everyone's future.」

stage0098a_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$バナージ$$
（The future... possibility...
　I'm off, $$オードリー$$...）

stage0098a_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$リディ$$
（Let it go for now...
　Chrono, and $$オードリー$$ too,
　all of it can wait until I'm back...）

stage0098a_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$クェス$$
「Let's do our best, Hasa.
　We're humanity's hope, after all.」

stage0098a_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I'm not too confident about that, though...」

stage0098a_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$クェス$$
「Ugh, you're so unreliable...!
　Well then, I'm... going to go see the Colonel.」

stage0098a_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「The Colonel's talking with Captain $$アムロ$$ right now.
　Let's leave the two of them alone.」

stage0098a_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$クェス$$
「Those two... have a strange relationship, don't they.」

stage0098a_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$チェーン$$
「A lot's happened, but now we're comrades fighting together.」

stage0098a_03:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$クェス$$
「That's true, $$チェーン$$.
　...Are you still mad at me?」

stage0098a_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$チェーン$$
「No.
　Because now, we're comrades fighting together too.」

stage0098a_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$チェーン$$
「But I'm not giving up the Captain.」

stage0098a_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$クェス$$
「Ugh... you are still a little mad, after all...」

stage0098a_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:

「...I believe in your victory, $$キラ$$.」

（$$クェス$$...
　We might not see each other again, but...
　I'll do my best, for your sake too.）

stage0098a_03:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$シン$$
「Come to think of it, where are Captain $$アムロ$$ and Colonel $$シャア$$?」

stage0098a_03:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Those two are talking over there.」

stage0098a_03:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$シャア$$
「No use putting up a brave front with you, is there...」

stage0098a_03:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$アムロ$$
「But we can't let humanity end here.」

stage0098a_03:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$アムロ$$
「The evolution of humanity that the $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ fear...
　I wonder how far people can go...」

stage0098a_03:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I want to see it for myself.
　Where people are headed.」

stage0098a_03:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Whether a day will really come when
　people can control even time itself...」

stage0098a_03:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$シャア$$
「So meeting $$ララァ$$ was what started this, huh...」

stage0098a_03:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$シャア$$
「Seems neither of us can quite let go of the past.」

stage0098a_03:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$アムロ$$
「It's not the past.
　It's a precious memory.」

stage0098a_03:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I'll keep moving forward together with it.
　Me too... all of us, humanity too.」

stage0098a_03:r_d90c4affdd742a0e.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$アムロ・レイ$$ and $$シャア・アズナブル$$...
　Seems those two are on your mind.」

stage0098a_03:r_082a55c75a163780.text:
$$刹那$$
「Is that what it means to understand one another...?」

stage0098a_03:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$カトル$$
「Neither of them seem much different from usual, do they.」

stage0098a_03:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Don't you two have someone you
　want to see at a time like this?」

stage0098a_03:r_c4cdd41ba9207e9c.text:
$$トロワ$$
「It's that attitude that gets you saddled with a bad nickname.」

stage0098a_03:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Guess that's the final word, coming from $$トロワ$$.」

stage0098a_03:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Why don't you two... write a letter?」

stage0098a_03:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Vice Minister $$リリーナ$$ and Ambassador $$マリナ$$ are both busy too.
　If going to see them isn't possible, at least send a letter.」

stage0098a_03:r_38f89a2d27debb9e.text:
$$五飛$$
「Not an honest one either, is he.」

stage0098a_03:r_20aab898d4d14e51.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Coming from you, even $$ヒイロ$$ deserves some sympathy.」

stage0098a_03:r_e418ba9e04898c28.text:
$$マリー$$
「But I'm sure he'll get his feelings across to someone precious to him too.」

stage0098a_03:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Guess I'll pray that letter doesn't get torn up.」

stage0098a_03:r_f79b2ac118e41c1a.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Well... having someone like that,
　that's happiness.」

stage0098a_03:r_d7bf635b7e5f811c.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「I'll agree with that much.」

stage0098a_03:r_3f9082480d045564.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Major, is there someone you want
　to tell how you feel?」

stage0098a_03:r_312a78dfbb065f65.text:
$$グラハム$$
「I still need time before I can
　face them.」

stage0098a_03:r_9f17991d2b19374c.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「That's stiff.
　Well... I sent a video mail to the
　Colonel, no, the Brigadier General.」

stage0098a_03:r_9bf1948e282e5587.text:
$$ノイン$$
「As expected of Happy $$コーラサワー$$.」

stage0098a_03:r_67c9e002d64d9781.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Don't you have someone to tell
　your feelings to?」

stage0098a_03:r_cb5e5d90104f7a88.text:
$$ノイン$$
「It's enough for me just to be
　walking the same road.」

stage0098a_03:r_8246cdac0973a25f.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「$$ゼクス・マーキス$$...
　I'll give you the codename Happy
　$$プリベンター$$ Wind.」

stage0098a_03:r_0a597f4cd9c8309b.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「I appreciate the thought, but
　I'll have to decline.」

stage0098a_03:r_fc7afc4ebf9fd013.text:
$$グラハム$$
「I'd like to be able to give that
　word to all of humanity.」

stage0098a_03:r_1608d4c4d3f78b24.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Major, is there someone you want
　to tell how you feel?」

stage0098a_03:r_149109e3b1cf253b.text:
$$グラハム$$
「I still need time before I can
　face them.」

stage0098a_03:r_1de04d77f1060720.text:
$$グラハム$$
「And you? Shouldn't you be spending
　time together, just the two of you?」

stage0098a_03:r_bc2050dd9e12f5a4.text:
$$ノイン$$
「It's enough for me just to be
　walking the same road.」

stage0098a_03:r_5149abbbcbee6ee4.text:
$$グラハム$$
「Well then, I'll take my leave.
　My friend, $$プリベンター$$ Wind...
　blessings upon you both.」

stage0098a_03:r_bedf0f18c13c0a97.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「That word... I'd like to be able
　to give it to all of humanity.」

stage0098a_03:r_490618028b4c53d6.text:
$$アルト$$
「Even at a time like this, he's
　exactly the same as always.」

stage0098a_03:r_1a6f62daa82363ae.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Where are Captain $$オズマ$$ and
　Lieutenant $$カナリア$$?」

stage0098a_03:r_6b6dd25816c18fc5.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「The Lieutenant's off with family in
　the fleet, and the Captain's obviously
　with Lieutenant $$キャシー$$.」

stage0098a_03:r_9d80dc88f241858b.text:
$$アルト$$
「Everyone's gone to be with
　someone important to them...」

stage0098a_03:r_23cb7be357e8a4e0.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「What about you?
　It's a good chance, shouldn't you tell
　them how you really feel?」

stage0098a_03:r_60cd511150394b50.text:
$$アルト$$
「I'm not about to act like this is
　some final farewell.」

stage0098a_03:r_7fc1d3642481712b.text:
$$アルト$$
「I'll do that once I can bring
　victory home as a gift.」

stage0098a_03:r_0153901fe839b497.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「OK, $$アルト$$.
　Guess that means we've got to
　come back alive, no matter what.」

stage0098a_03:r_336f0b1ef99d93b3.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「$$アルト$$, today... he looks
　kind of nice.」

stage0098a_03:r_f4f785c3e285cb39.text:
$$ガムリン$$
（I thought I'd use this chance to
　ask Ms. $$ミレーヌ$$ how she feels...
　I've still got a long way to go...）

stage0098a_03:r_eb4bb0599c61e2b2.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Well then, shall we get going?」

stage0098a_03:r_1a9f38456bfe7b4a.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Yes.
　It's a bit of a distance, so let's hurry.」

stage0098a_03:r_6f761a8fd9d1f7b4.text:
$$アルト$$
（Time spent with someone important...
　I wonder how Mr. $$桂$$ is doing...）

stage0098a_03:r_c0837a2b98000559.text:
$$モーム$$
「Master $$桂$$...!
　What are you going to do with
　all this shopping?!」

stage0098a_03:r_0866340ed1139b99.text:
$$桂$$
「The dimensional boundary's gone
　unstable again. Which means we might
　finally be able to get back to Mimsy.」

stage0098a_03:r_290faeefba2fe68d.text:
$$モーム$$
「Could this be...
　a souvenir for everyone at
　$$ファクトリー$$?」

stage0098a_03:r_65ef57e28bd90298.text:
$$桂$$
「That's the idea.
　Battles at the edge of space, plus today's
　shopping, all souvenirs for my love back home.」

stage0098a_03:r_bbc100b0424fdcd0.text:
$$桂$$
（Speaking of love, the Element folks...
　I bet they're getting worked up
　about now, huh?）

stage0098a_03:r_d9ad0726bf16dd92.text:
$$アマタ$$
（My father and mother entrusted me
　with the future of Altair and Vega...
　the two worlds.）

stage0098a_03:r_821a93f3f890d905.text:
$$アマタ$$
（I'll protect it, I swear...
　Vega... our Earth.）

stage0098a_03:r_8cb00be7cca91c45.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Don't push yourself too hard, $$アマタ$$.」

stage0098a_03:r_ce4ee5d4d2a4dc1d.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Huh...?
　Was I... saying that out loud?」

stage0098a_03:r_5557ccda2f7c3f23.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「No.
　But I can tell... when it comes
　to you, $$アマタ$$.」

stage0098a_03:r_ae273a5479d64978.text:
$$カグラ$$
「That bastard $$アマタ$$...
　flaunting it like that.」

stage0098a_03:r_28066ae0934e6411.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Still hung up on $$ミコノ$$?
　Not very manly of you, $$カグラ$$.」

stage0098a_03:r_a38016b9c3d59e6e.text:
$$カグラ$$
「It's not that.
　I just got a little irritated,
　that's all.」

stage0098a_03:r_9d00ee0ac3902eac.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Work it off with your body, then.
　Come spar with me.」

stage0098a_03:r_258a09e5e9761e3d.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Fine by me.
　I'll take you on till you've
　had more than enough.」

stage0098a_03:r_e5630cc47dc440b7.text:
$$アンディ$$
「That day at the hot spring...
　let me say again what I
　couldn't get out right.」

stage0098a_03:r_8f39e18936c36a15.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Let's save that for after
　we get back.
　So... don't you dare die, $$アンディ$$.」

stage0098a_03:r_ee7f46e6a631fd5c.text:
$$シュレード$$
「A beautiful chord...
　I can feel the world's harmony.」

stage0098a_03:r_959b2fde0469959d.text:
$$カイエン$$
「We'll crush any $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$
　that tries to disturb it.」

stage0098a_03:r_586ac0e9503b5765.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「It's nothing but couples,
　everywhere I look!」

stage0098a_03:r_1d13d9bb6a6d7818.text:
$$モロイ$$
「Hold on.
　The last pair doesn't count.」

stage0098a_03:r_dc37213133cd8177.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「No way...!
　That one was the best pairing too!」

stage0098a_03:r_95a0cdf4151c12f7.text:
$$クレア$$
（$$不動$$...
　I'm sure they'll pull it off.）

stage0098a_03:r_c2a5e2a9019026a4.text:
$$クレア$$
（So please, watch over them...
　And over humanity.）

stage0098a_03:r_855e82ce06693ee8.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Well then, Chairwoman $$クレア$$...
　I'm off.」

stage0098a_03:r_3c1c81e93f697fb9.text:
$$クレア$$
「Don't forget the souvenir donuts,
　now.」

stage0098a_03:r_10cbf30c54cfe4fc.text:
$$シュレード$$
「I'll have something truly
　exceptional ready.」

stage0098a_03:r_d84831042f10325c.text:
$$アマタ$$
（I wonder what everyone at Team D's
　up to... Maybe they went off somewhere
　together, just like us...）

「Huh...?
　Was I... saying that out loud?」

stage0098a_03:r_c98d1f9a0e601947.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「No.
　But I can tell... when it comes
　to you, $$アマタ$$.」

stage0098a_03:r_8b22d4b99ca35b84.text:
$$カグラ$$
「That bastard $$アマタ$$...
　flaunting it like that.」

stage0098a_03:r_b0aaf075b2a97a36.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Still hung up on $$ミコノ$$?
　Not very manly of you, $$カグラ$$.」

stage0098a_03:r_53add6e443d8a65a.text:
$$カグラ$$
「It's not that.
　I just got a little irritated,
　that's all.」

stage0098a_03:r_447e23c61fa29c56.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Work it off with your body, then.
　Come spar with me.」

stage0098a_03:r_d95bdcd1bd8b6579.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Fine by me.
　I'll take you on till you've
　had more than enough.」

stage0098a_03:r_941d9e3a330b1087.text:
$$アンディ$$
「That day at the hot spring...
　let me say again what I
　couldn't get out right.」

stage0098a_03:r_bee2bfb994ca7365.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Let's save that for after
　we get back.
　So... don't you dare die, $$アンディ$$.」

stage0098a_03:r_4d54e46ed7fd462d.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「It's nothing but couples,
　everywhere I look!」

stage0098a_03:r_1c42d2bca3a5e3a3.text:
$$モロイ$$
「Being single's a lonely thing,
　at times like this...」

stage0098a_03:r_b23f4e273f76c5a8.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Cut it out...!
　The leftovers hooking up with each
　other, what a lazy turn of events!」

stage0098a_03:r_2488b984097a7bdf.text:
$$モロイ$$
「Even a universal lover like me
　draws the line at you!」

stage0098a_03:r_0491c741ae20f5e6.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「What are you thinking about,
　Mr. $$カイエン$$?」

stage0098a_03:r_131bea3d5d957e98.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Probably the same as you, $$ユノハ$$.」

stage0098a_03:r_18ef8ab6be368d72.text:
$$カイエン$$
（I'm heading out, my dear friend
　$$シュレード$$...）

stage0098a_03:r_176fd2544c64e83e.text:
$$ユノハ$$
（I'm... going to do my best.
　So, $$ジン$$... please watch over me...）

stage0098a_03:r_ae2ea53f43e74074.text:
$$クレア$$
（$$不動$$...
　I'm sure they'll pull it off.）

stage0098a_03:r_60e8a3284b8a113b.text:
$$クレア$$
（So please, watch over them...
　And over humanity.）

stage0098a_03:r_d4164c459c1c1165.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Well then, Chairwoman $$クレア$$...
　I'm off.」

stage0098a_03:r_e745974656b70e6a.text:
$$クレア$$
「Don't forget the souvenir donuts,
　now.」

stage0098a_03:r_f794dabe545dc6ac.text:
$$アマタ$$
（I wonder what everyone at Team D's
　up to... Maybe they went off somewhere
　together, just like us...）

stage0098a_03:r_aab85855cbaf5596.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Oh... where has everyone from Team D gone?」

stage0098a_03:r_e5f4d0fca11502fa.text:
$$セイミー$$
「I think $$ジョニー$$ and $$エイーダ$$ are on a date,
　but I'm not sure about the others.」

stage0098a_03:r_f3ed55718d2364ba.text:
$$ルゥ$$
「It seems everyone's gone out somewhere, each on their own.」

stage0098a_03:r_47fd2ac2e2a8e945.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Acting on their own right to the end, hm...
　Some things never change.」

stage0098a_03:r_95ef381ed0b96982.text:
$$ルゥ$$
「But there's plenty that has changed too.」

stage0098a_03:r_82218191e135e576.text:
$$セイミー$$
「They're different from when we first met...
　Those kids have changed, gotten stronger.」

stage0098a_03:r_c4e4b578079583c5.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Well, of course...
　After all, they're the strongest Team D in history.」

stage0098a_03:r_46c21ad643c64977.text:
$$ルゥ$$
（Speaking of someone who loves solitude...
　I wonder what they're thinking, at a time like this...）

stage0098a_03:r_6c3c0ada303bce08.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「Were you thinking about $$エンジェル$$?」

stage0098a_03:r_c5d536c5ba8c0902.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「You do have a lot on your mind.」

stage0098a_03:r_243595675818fcae.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「That's true...
　I was thinking about every woman and man in the world, after all.」

stage0098a_03:r_61c5480dbf2e58e0.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「The world needs a future.
　Let's go protect it, $$ドロシー#240$$.」

stage0098a_03:r_2e966de2770bb703.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「So that's the request you received from people all over the world.」

stage0098a_03:r_02c89111c680d125.text:
$$ロジャー$$
（I'm sure he's steeling his resolve
　in the same way, behind his mask.）

stage0098a_03:r_3f09ae47d355cbc5.text:
$$カレン$$
「Then you could take off the mask, couldn't you?」

stage0098a_03:r_5777cb06f7e0103f.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「An earnest man.
　Though 'damn' belongs stuck to the front of that.」

stage0098a_03:r_ede6dd5bb2efe029.text:
$$カレン$$
「That's way too harsh, calling him an earnest damn man!」

stage0098a_03:r_98e716ed18b1b3a2.text:
$$スザク$$
「That's not where it's supposed to attach.」

stage0098a_03:r_e81e034b71411af7.text:
$$カレン$$
「Already? Since we're here, let's take a walk around the school.」

stage0098a_03:r_e83ac0db54ff2b02.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「If someone spots us, it'll be a hassle.」

stage0098a_03:r_f2d72b948cc38cfe.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「What are you doing, $$スザク$$!?」

stage0098a_03:r_017c609cb5528ca1.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Stop acting meek all of a sudden.
　It's bad luck, and it doesn't suit you at all.」

stage0098a_03:r_5ce10ef5943775df.text:
$$スザク$$
「...This academy is where it all began for us.」

stage0098a_03:r_444bfe868b096710.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「We met, we parted, we hated, we loved...」

stage0098a_03:r_864ee68806b41af1.text:
$$カレン$$
「A fitting place to steel our resolve for the final battle.」

stage0098a_03:r_5c69712b1b3fb77b.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Is that all right, $$カレン$$?
　Wallow in sentiment and we'll be late for the meeting.」

stage0098a_03:r_f8c886fa821c5334.text:
$$カレン$$
「That's why I'm hurrying. Let's go, everyone...!」

stage0098a_03:r_a4366814d6972533.text:
$$ルルーシュ$$
（$$ナナリー$$... and everyone precious to me...
　I swear I will... $$ゼロ$$ will protect the world.）

stage0098a_03:r_ce4b924038c181a0.text:
$$カレン$$
（$$キリコ$$...
　So you've come to this $$新日本$$ too...）

stage0098a_03:r_bdfc9cb5d9aaf4ce.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「$$キリコ$$, you've got a visitor.」

stage0098a_03:r_5430d9d76e38cf47.text:
$$バニラ$$
「$$カレン$$ told us you went out alone,
　so we figured you'd be here.」

stage0098a_03:r_1711e6c6939aa411.text:
$$ココナ$$
「This is where it all started for us and $$キリコ$$, after all.」

stage0098a_03:r_1efac5b6d8fb1238.text:
$$キリコ$$
「This is the city where I met $$フィアナ$$ again, too...」

stage0098a_03:r_b661c876eb7a4d72.text:
$$ココナ$$
「We'll see each other again, right...?」

stage0098a_03:r_bdf41f6a0fb7b286.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Don't forget, $$キリコ$$.
　That there are at least this many
　people waiting for you.」

stage0098a_03:r_d4488f1ef5175d87.text:
$$キリコ$$
（$$宗介$$...
　Don't end up like me...）

stage0098a_03:r_4f98756e8506f766.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Hangar

stage0098a_03:r_722be3d36da4979c.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Hangar

stage0098a_03:r_4f838d45a89974f0.text: $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ Hangar

stage0098a_03:r_99e939138611b349.text: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, Hangar ～

stage0098a_03:r_b8aead2ff492ad33.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Where are $$マオ$$ and $$クルツ$$?」

stage0098a_03:r_e18660f45e2bdaae.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$クルツ$$ forced an invitation on her, and they went out.」

stage0098a_03:r_f2a506c32c68b595.text:
$$宗介$$
「Lieutenant $$クルーゾー$$ is holed up in his quarters.
　He's barred anyone from entering,
　so he's probably concentrating.」

stage0098a_03:r_366eed12d0fa7297.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Really?
　When I saw him earlier he was carrying some
　disc, so isn't he just watching it in his room?」

stage0098a_03:r_53dd6bae12e095c3.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Might be some surprising hobby of his...」

stage0098a_03:r_888c0b4c627ecec4.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...Your imagination jumps way too far...」

stage0098a_03:r_0ee1b4c987332e23.text:
$$宗介$$
「What do you mean by indecent, Captain?
　Is it a matter of some kind of bacteria, or data on an endemic disease?」

stage0098a_03:r_96d6ee6ffbd6d1e6.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...I don't even have the energy to call that out...」

stage0098a_03:r_86a99be7bc977b4a.text:
$$宗介$$
「No problem.
　Storming the $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$'s home base
　is our job.」

stage0098a_03:r_83e0e74db0ae4d4f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「What do I do...
　We're about to sortie, and I'm suddenly exhausted...」

stage0098a_03:r_d85829b2f9bff450.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Well then, $$かなめ$$...
　please spend these three days of leave relaxing.」

stage0098a_03:r_d45ebbbfa8153f69.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...Are you sure, $$テッサ$$?
　Spending your whole leave tuning the Danaan...」

stage0098a_03:r_518305c95e4d1da4.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I can't keep leaving this child's
　control to you forever, $$かなめ$$.
　I'll do everything I can.」

stage0098a_03:r_78ebe98c49194738.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Look...
　if you're pushing yourself just to
　leave me behind on Earth, stop it.」

stage0098a_03:r_85121e18387bbee9.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I've got the resolve of a temporary
　$c member too, you know.」

stage0098a_03:r_58b16d8cc9b8a2a5.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Thank you, $$かなめ$$.
　That's exactly why I want you and Sagara
　to spend this leave meaningfully.」

stage0098a_03:r_5cf3d385c6d4b8d0.text:
$$テッサ$$
「This is my own way of thanking you both,
　for always helping someone as inexperienced as me.」

stage0098a_03:r_808269c7e458f2a5.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Before apologizing, go enjoy your leave to the fullest.」

stage0098a_03:r_f6f98a8ef73d1d43.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Thanks, $$テッサ$$.
　Well... let's go, $$宗介$$.」

stage0098a_03:r_3d395121b4205722.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$シンジ$$ and the others are probably meeting friends right about now, too.」

stage0098a_03:r_a93aa11c23414e87.text: ～ Municipal Junior High School No. 1 Schoolyard ～

stage0098a_03:r_d243a6836b127987.text:
$$アスカ$$
「...So we ended up coming here after all.」

stage0098a_03:r_cbab585f941e5667.text:
$$シンジ$$
「If there's somewhere else you wanted to go,
　you could've just gone there...」

stage0098a_03:r_0e1caed2ba333f4e.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Listen here...!
　I'm going out of my way to keep you company,
　so show a little more gratitude.」

stage0098a_03:r_a9e024bdcd6975b2.text:
$$トウジ$$
「I see, I see.
　You two... ended up in that kind of
　relationship before I knew it, huh.」

stage0098a_03:r_978bd43401f7be8a.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Like anything like that would happen with stupid $$シンジ$$!」

stage0098a_03:r_e9bd6b1804d36e0a.text:
$$ヒカリ$$
「But compared to when you called him
　'Daddy's Boy', you two seem to get along better now.」

stage0098a_03:r_7aac40a4f34dcec3.text:
$$トウジ$$
「So really... how is it, $$シンジ$$?」

stage0098a_03:r_e174d36b825c4290.text:
$$トウジ$$
「If we're late, the girls'll have our hides!」

stage0098a_03:r_160384a0c68215c6.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Thank you, Ayanami.
　You really saved me back there.」

stage0098a_03:r_577385dbd6d74922.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「...Don't you need to see Commander Ikari?」

stage0098a_03:r_ee134f0fa96047a6.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I'll... report the victory to my father.」

stage0098a_03:r_1797d61f82be363c.text:
$$シンジ$$
（I bet $n has gone there by now...）

stage0098a_03:r_f2e19618032127d3.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「So you came here after all...」

stage0098a_03:r_21454fd877c0ae7b.text:
$$レイ#333$$
「Don't you need to see Commander Ikari?」

stage0098a_03:r_c8c3a682c9917367.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...As for the report, $$ミサト$$'s already taking care of that.」

stage0098a_03:r_09068a6fd74f79b7.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「You're late, $$シンジ$$!
　What were you doing!」

stage0098a_03:r_4ff0d278b79d1168.text:
$$トウジ$$
「If we're late, the girls'll have our hides!」

stage0098a_03:r_6bdc8a8243c655ed.text:
$$シンジ$$
「She said she had something to do today...」

stage0098a_03:r_72be9250b889c959.text:
$$トウジ$$
「Still no team player, is she...!
　Boss $$カレン$$'s gonna have to set her straight.」

stage0098a_03:r_0831afdf480052ed.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I might not see you all for a while...
　So let's enjoy today.」

stage0098a_03:r_b402ecf2db57f319.text:
$$シンジ$$
（I'm off, $$アスカ$$...
　And... Father...）

stage0098a_03:r_f581e32ff0b84e01.text:
$$シンジ$$
（I bet $n has gone there by now...）

stage0098a_03:r_eb56670c83981cc6.text:
$$マキ$$
「Until just recently they were terribly frightened,
　but now, unbelievably, they're both calm.」

stage0098a_03:r_90b6cb0493a2982b.text:
$n
「So they're on their way to recovery.」

stage0098a_03:r_7accc1b1cfd86010.text:
$$マキ$$
「I'm glad you keep coming to see me like this,
　but sometimes I can't reach you at all when I call...」

stage0098a_03:r_59a1074cc884fdbd.text:
$$マキ$$
「You don't need to worry so much about it.
　I'm the type who doesn't mind waiting.」

stage0098a_03:r_b66bbe1f07a7674e.text:
$$マキ$$
「But I do want you to tell me.
　Why you're so busy, $n.」

stage0098a_03:r_fa7a261c85f92c5a.text:
$$マキ$$
「What's that...!
　That's a bit surprising!」

stage0098a_03:r_fb72b64c842ba487.text:
$$マキ$$
「When do you think we can meet again?」

stage0098a_03:r_54e755252ec3acc4.text:
$$マキ$$
「Well, when it works out, let me know, okay?
　It's a promise, $n.」

stage0098a_03:r_93b46e3c24ed4825.text:
$$スズネ$$
「You're the last one, $n.
　Everyone else is already gathered in the clubroom.」

stage0098a_03:r_d7cd6f0e351ca403.text:
$n
「Did you come to pick me up?」

stage0098a_03:r_4b3e91da51d87c72.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Having a partner who's always late is such a hassle.」

stage0098a_03:r_912c58272c320559.text:
$n
「...Don't you need to go see someone too,
　Miss $$スズネ$$?」

stage0098a_03:r_5f455447e0703bcf.text:
$$スズネ$$
「...I don't have that many people I know
　in this world...」

stage0098a_03:r_0a93eeae43e226f4.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Didn't I tell you?
　That I was thrown into this world alone, four years ago.」

stage0098a_03:r_5d3ee1804aedfa48.text:
$$スズネ$$
「It's not that unusual a story, is it?
　$$ノリコ$$'s much the same, after all...」

stage0098a_03:r_b99c671eb373edd1.text:
$$スズネ$$
「But maybe that's exactly why...
　I can't just leave you alone, $n.」

stage0098a_03:r_0f9b6f684aa8f438.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Because I was alone too,
　just like you, $n...」

stage0098a_03:r_cd3b88564d0672c9.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Because here at Jindai High, and with $c,
　I got to meet people who matter to me.」

stage0098a_03:r_ed6e99341ad5bf40.text:
$n
「...I lost my father and my sister,
　lost everything, and came to this school...」

stage0098a_03:r_a671f14759794503.text:
$n
「But now I can say it.
　This is what I need to protect...」

stage0098a_03:r_7ff5aecfd0f37b20.text:
$n
「So... even if it's a one-way ticket with no way home,
　let's go and protect it,
　even if it takes us to the ends of the galaxy.」

stage0098a_03:r_121b55dcb47984aa.text:
$$スズネ$$
「...But you know, $n...
　I think my charm point is... these glasses.」

stage0098a_03:r_a378a46f62b5980d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Going bare-eyed while piloting $$ジェニオン$$ is comfortable too,
　but the glasses just feel more like me.」

stage0098a_03:r_5aa4e72c511af6eb.text:
$n
「Yes...
　I won't call it a one-way ticket.」

stage0098a_03:r_8e2f92d078970a2b.text:
$n
「Let's live... and come home.
　And someday... when peace returns...」

stage0098a_03:r_e8ecfd162319c1e6.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Yes...
　Let's get out of $$ジェニオン$$ together.」

stage0098a_03:r_84158af5a79e4d35.text:
$$正太郎$$
「The elementary school group's all here.」

stage0098a_03:r_ebc3eec9f9e218b1.text:
$$かなめ$$
「$$恭子$$!
　And everyone from Class 2-4 too!」

stage0098a_03:r_271fbb35b579a866.text:
$$風間$$
「It's not just us.
　There's people from other classes, first-years, third-years too.」

stage0098a_03:r_b40fe3d3e6f2b1d9.text:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「We heard you guys were coming to school for the first time in a while.
　Everyone wanted to see you.」

stage0098a_03:r_3fb74a41e682c7de.text:
$$詩織$$
「That's right.
　Everyone's been waiting for the Volunteer Club.」

stage0098a_03:r_d1b8cb87f8ea00d6.text:
$$林水$$
「Let's get right to it.
　There's a huge backlog of requests for you to clear.」

stage0098a_03:r_199a6e6247ffb58b.text:
$$蓮$$
「Helping out the athletic clubs, repairing damage around school,
　leveling the flowerbeds, maintaining the schoolyard, sorting library books,
　mediating disputes between the culture clubs...」

stage0098a_03:r_6095c82e60cdd7af.text:
$$蓮$$
「And there are all sorts of other requests coming in too.」

stage0098a_03:r_48a06834bb510d7d.text:
$$恭子$$
「Isn't that what the Volunteer Club is for?」

stage0098a_03:r_48fd2b5d0978ba1c.text:
$$アルト$$
「W-what do you mean, what are we gonna do...」

stage0098a_03:r_90591ae4aa6d92d6.text:
$$宗介$$
「We have no choice but to do it, $$アルト$$.」

stage0098a_03:r_3c39aed29379134c.text:
$$アルト$$
「Fine, then!
　We'll start from the basics!」

stage0098a_03:r_bff5468c57365d6b.text:
$$アルト$$
「Volunteer Club president to members!
　First, we start by picking up trash around the school!」

stage0098a_03:r_9520c4f160aa3ebd.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Seriously, that's what it comes down to!?」

stage0098a_03:r_9dc3c6963e7dac77.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Let's stop complaining and get started.
　...Of course, everyone who's gathered here
　will help out too, right?」

stage0098a_03:r_e839f83a2e7828b1.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Of course.
　It's everyone's school, so let's all clean it up together.」

stage0098a_03:r_7d5585f6d8b1df8d.text:
$$かなめ$$
「All right, let's do this, everyone!」

stage0098a_03:r_0d848a222f69347d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「When we're done, let's all go get Galaxy Ramen
　and Andromeda-yaki together.
　My treat.」

stage0098a_03:r_77fc21c69be0890c.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Heh heh... If there's a reward,
　wouldn't everyone want to volunteer?」

stage0098a_03:r_7b9baf664ed0cd70.text:
$$宗介$$
「No... what matters is the spirit of it.」

stage0098a_03:r_a0fcf4d8788a2bce.text:
$$アルト$$
「That's the idea, everyone.
　Let's get moving already!」

stage0098a_03:r_d8483ee925825d04.text:
$n
「Looks like this is going to be a meaningful vacation.」

stage0098a_03:r_55d74e6e4298cda9.text:
$$ノリコ$$
（Big Sis's photo...
　It's faded so much...）

stage0098a_03:r_a8286dce43de45a6.text:
$$ノリコ$$
（I... was sent to this world all alone,
　so there's no one I need to go see...）

stage0098a_03:r_e1b7430fdaa24f35.text:
$$ノリコ$$
（But, in my heart, Big Sis is always there.
　So...）

stage0098a_03:r_683f2ca0d6804be4.text:
$$甲児$$
「I'm back, $$ノリコ$$.
　Here... a robot anime disc, a souvenir from Japan.」

stage0098a_03:r_d96c64f9a77d53aa.text:
$$アルト$$
「And this is that tokusatsu model kit you wanted.」

stage0098a_03:r_da78018881956191.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Eh... isn't the vacation until tomorrow...」

stage0098a_03:r_4267b07b216d5d90.text:
$n
「I was going to spend the last day
　with my $c comrades... or so I'd decided...」

stage0098a_03:r_1a9b7326b53f45cc.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Looks like everyone was thinking the same thing.」

stage0098a_03:r_02b69055356d9cfb.text:
$$葵$$
「So in the end, the vacation's over after two days.」

stage0098a_03:r_c4554163734c62f1.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Here, $$ノリコ$$...!
　These are my mom's homemade croquettes.」

stage0098a_03:r_890ab04baf542979.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Everyone else brought back souvenirs too,
　so let's make this a send-off party.」

stage0098a_03:r_7123af524c72acf7.text:
$$ノリコ$$
（Big Sis...
　I... wasn't alone after all.）

stage0098a_03:r_0b8e88db1a9dd44e.text:
$$ノリコ$$
（This world, full of people I love so much,
　$$ノリコ$$ will protect it too, with everything she's got.）

stage0098a_03:r_31f18ff9dc8f076e.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Not bad, $$キタン$$.
　Good timing on that follow-up.」

stage0098a_03:r_b4515f604561df78.text:
$$キタン$$
「Heh... I haven't gotten older for nothing.」

stage0098a_03:r_3cf33f3773748d0f.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「But you know, $$キタン$$...
　the Dai-Gurren Brigade made it this far because you were there.」

stage0098a_03:r_533e554662b8c631.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「$$シモン$$ pulled us forward from up ahead,
　and you pushed us up from below...
　That's how I see it.」

stage0098a_03:r_cbff35a90e8ad7cd.text:
$$キタン$$
「I'm glad too!
　That I got to fight alongside you like this!」

stage0098a_03:r_26db4dd6c24f9835.text:
$$キタン$$
「And yeah, it just wouldn't be
　the Dai-Gurren Brigade without your boobs!」

stage0098a_03:r_d224d5baf3493ab2.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「You idiot!
　I'll make you stand in the hallway!」

stage0098a_03:r_180eb1536d754e3c.text:
$$マオ$$
「Isn't it your fault, as his coach?
　Letting a perfect chance like that slip by.」

stage0098a_03:r_015674a403ccf13a.text:
$$クルツ$$
「I'm a sniper, and a Snooper!
　I don't coach anyone into missing a target they've got locked on!」

stage0098a_03:r_ef91c7636fe8aad4.text:
$$ダリー$$
「$$クルツ$$...
　please don't give snipers
　such a bad image...」

stage0098a_03:r_397bc0c659cbf227.text:
$$ギミー$$
「Anyway, it's not $$クルツ$$'s fault this time.
　$$キタン$$'s just not careful enough.」

stage0098a_03:r_f2effcece0132e9d.text:
$$ダリー$$
「True...
　We should learn from $$ダヤッカ$$ in that regard.」

stage0098a_03:r_f7c5d0246e396cd5.text:
$$ギミー$$
「It's less about $$ダヤッカ$$ himself there,
　more that $$キヨウ$$'s the impressive one.」

stage0098a_03:r_7aa9edfa8692bb8d.text:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「$$キヨウ$$... we need to talk...」

stage0098a_03:r_20d5fb63b23b2310.text:
$$キヨウ$$
「You want to go with everyone, don't you?」

stage0098a_03:r_f30ba6c950a686bc.text:
$$キヨウ$$
「This is the Dai-Gurren Brigade and $c's
　final big brawl, isn't it?
　How can $$ダヤッカ$$ of Littner Village sit this one out!」

stage0098a_03:r_6bfb2bfe97891db7.text:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「I'm glad it's you!
　I'm glad I married you...!」

stage0098a_03:r_96474b2c3a6e7165.text:
$$キヨウ$$
「...You idiot.
　But make sure you protect the Earth properly.
　And come back safe, too.」

stage0098a_03:r_023f1f7532dd508f.text:
$$キタン$$
「Looks like that's everyone accounted for, then.」

stage0098a_03:r_87d57a77ad22ca35.text:
$$キタン$$
「That's right!
　The biggest brawl in the universe, to save the woman I love!」

stage0098a_03:r_88aa7aea54616b53.text:
$$キタン$$
「Heh... guess it can't be helped...
　Even knowing this is a battle for Earth's fate,
　part of me's still getting excited.」

stage0098a_03:r_ca13a7fc435dcc9d.text:
$$赤木$$
「Save the Earth, and rescue $$ニア$$-chan too!
　I'm doing both!」

stage0098a_03:r_8e980fa9b6fbb694.text:
$$キタン$$
（Let's do this, $$シモン$$...
　this is the final battle.）
